snippet.title: Who Can Help at Home? 🏠 You Can! A Beautiful Sunnah | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
The table is messy and everyone is busy... who can help? You can!

Someone once asked Lady Aisha (Radi Allahu Anha): what did our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) do at home? She said: he helped his family at home, and when it was time to pray, he went to pray.

Let's help at home too: tidy your toys, set the table and fold your clothes. Helping your family is a beautiful sunnah, and it makes everyone smile!

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 676: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:676

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: muhammadarhamamin77800 on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-198164/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. All characters are faceless.
